tool: Independent read-only source/pad equivalence, graph and GND projection audit

DSI_D0_P.length_convention: Sum of every same-net track/arc centerline plus nominal outer copper midplane separation for each F-B through-via, derived from the saved stackup. Includes branches in total. Terminal contact inside pad is zero; pad propagation is omitted. This is geometry, not measured delay or whole-channel SI.

GND_reference_projection.method: Uses already-saved native filled GND polygons, unioned per copper layer. F.Cu projects onto In1.Cu; B.Cu onto In2.Cu. Every outer non-GND track sampled at <=specified pitch at center and both trace edges. Own signal-via transition holes are reported separately, not counted as reference-plane proof.
limitations: A 2D projection check only; does not prove actual field distribution, continuous return inductance, reference-via proximity, impedance or EMI.
Areas are unions of native saved fill polygons; no fill operation performed. Thermal, plane-neck and antipad impedance need routing/field review.
Samples are not a proof against discontinuities narrower than the sampling pitch. Three lateral probes are not continuous full-width coverage.
Same-net trace centerline in a via antipad region is an expected transition location, but transition quality is not automatically accepted.
No board/project file is written. Output JSON is the only write.
DRC and ERC are independent required checks and must be run separately; this report does not assume their results.
Track centerline plus nominal outer copper midplane separation per via is a geometric length convention, not measured delay or a full channel model.
Filled-plane samples and islands do not prove reference return impedance, thermal capacity, actual manufacturability or exact connector/FPC qualification.
